name: context-band
description: Live context-window monitor above the Claude Code prompt that tells you when to compact: turns until auto-compaction, overhead and MCP cost before the first message, growth per turn, and warnings at thresholds you set. All 16 data points are configurable.

showBar.title: Stacked bar
showBar.description: A bar of the context window, one colour per /context category

showPercent.title: Percent and tokens
showPercent.description: Percent of the window used, and tokens used out of the window

showGrowth.title: Growth last turn
showGrowth.description: How many tokens the last turn added

showTrend.title: Growth trend
showTrend.description: A sparkline of the growth of the last eight turns

showTurnsLeft.title: Turns until auto-compact
showTurnsLeft.description: Projected turns left before auto-compaction, from recent growth

showOverhead.title: Overhead
showOverhead.description: Tokens taken before any message: system prompt, tools, MCP, memory files and skills

showMcp.title: MCP tools
showMcp.description: Tokens the loaded MCP tool schemas take, with the largest server

showLegend.title: Category legend
showLegend.description: Each /context category with its tokens, largest first

showTurnCount.title: Turn count
showTurnCount.description: Turns since the last compaction or /clear

showLastCompact.title: Last compaction
showLastCompact.description: Context size before and after the last compaction

showCacheHit.title: Prompt cache hit
showCacheHit.description: Share of the last request's input read from the prompt cache

showCost.title: Session cost
showCost.description: What the session has cost so far, as /cost totals it

showHint.title: Warning hint
showHint.description: A hint to /compact or /clear once the warning threshold is passed

toastOnWarn.title: Warning toast
toastOnWarn.description: A one-time toast when context passes the warning threshold

warnPercent.title: Warning at percent
warnPercent.description: Percent of the window at which the band turns yellow and the hint shows

dangerPercent.title: Danger at percent
dangerPercent.description: Percent of the window at which the band turns red

warnTokens.title: Warning at tokens
warnTokens.description: Also warn past this many tokens, whatever the window size (0 turns it off); useful on 1M windows
